title: Add Game: UI to create custom game profiles
description: Game toolbar/Settings "Add Game..." dialog that writes <config>/profiles/<name>.json for any Source game with a gameinfo.txt; prefill from gameinfo/FGDs/compile tools; optional tool_directory field in the profile JSON.
how_to_test: Automated: build/linux-clang-release/tests/apex_tests -tc='*GameProfile*,texture heap*' (pass). Manual: Games > Edit Game, set Default texture scale 0.5 and Texture filtering Nearest, save; the 3D view's textures turn pixelated and newly drawn brushes get scale 0.5 in the face editor. Switching back to Anisotropic/0.25 restores the default.

history.note: Built: assets::suggestGameProfile + gameProfileFileName, optional tool_directory JSON field (tool fallbacks for non-Strata layouts), GameProfileDialog, Game toolbar 'Games' menu (Add/Edit/Remove/Open Profiles Folder) + Settings > Add Game. Tests: 4 new asset cases, 2 UI cases; full apex_ui_tests 218/218 pass (clang-release).

Added GameProfile.features (rtLightModes, pbrShader; JSON "features", written only when non-default). Strata/P2CE detection keeps both on; other games suggest both off. RenderMirror::setEngineFeatures normalises light _specular/_direct/_indirect modes and disables the pbr shader path when off. Add Game dialog has two checkboxes. Tests added (profile round trip, suggest, mirror light gating).

Added GameProfile.textures (default new-solid texture scale + world texture filter: anisotropic/trilinear/bilinear/nearest). JSON "textures" written only when non-default. Add/Edit Game dialog exposes both. Scale applies to EditorSession new-solid style on profile/map change; filter switches TextureHeap sampler 0 in GpuHost::setDocument.
